chapter: Struttin' Time, chronology and Chicago singers
title: The Masonic Hall recording session in 1961
summary: Albertson recalls recording her at a Masonic Hall arranged by a Mason; he says it was not the best place.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now

blocks.x: Chris, I think the mike's fallen, hasn't it?
No, it's fine. He was the one who showed me the -- remember, we did it at the Masonic Hall?
-- got me to the Masonic Hall.
A Mason there -- he arranged that. But it was not a good place to record.
Well, you're going to take this other stuff later then, huh?
